investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the upstream ELB endpoint that backs POST /api/agents at /v1/agents — was unreachable at the time of the eval run. This is an infrastructure-layer failure at the swarm gateway boundary, not a failure in the eval runner or contract definitions. The root cause is uncertain between a transient network/ELB disruption and a sustained gateway outage, because no historical run data is available (previousRunCount=0) and no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the packet.
